title.narrative: Study visit agriculture from Ukraine to Netherlands

description.narrative: This project enables the implementation of the knowledge-to- knowledge incoming mission on Agriculture of the representatives of the Ukrainian universities to the Netherlands. This mission will enable the Ukrainian delegation to get practical understanding of Dutch experience of introducing regenerative agriculture in the Dutch agricultural education, help them establish direct contact with the representatives of the Dutch universities and enable both parties to discuss and develop joint proposals for creation of Dutch-Ukrainian agricultural digital educational platform. This mission is one of the key enabling environment interventions of the LAN team and LNV in Ukraine towards the development of sustainable agriculture during reconstruction.The project has a positive impact on:SDG 8: decent (inclusive and sustainable) work and economic growth.SDG 4 By 2030, substantially increase the number of youth and adults who have relevant skills, including technical and vocational skills, for employment, decent jobs and entrepreneurship.
Business development, by investment or trade of local or Dutch companies with(in) low and middle income countries

The results of this study visit has facilitated the establishments of direct networking and matchmaking with representatives of 5 Dutch educational institutions : - Farm of the future, Wageningen University, - Aeres education group - Dronten, - VET College Terra, - Hogeschool Van Hall Larenstein -UAS, - University of Applied Sciences HAS green academy,
During the roundtable that took place on October 3rd, the Dutch and Ukrainian participants defines the next steps for future collaboration in the following themes: setting up a digital educational platform, introduction of innovative approach to existing curriculum of Ukrainian universities to facilitate the interaction with the private sector (demo labs as part of the education system), in particular SMEs.
The Agriculture & Food Security Public Private Partnership Platform (TKI Agro NL) partiicipated in teh round table and provided information of the prioroty sectors whener the Dutch agro privatre scetopr could cooperate with the agricultural education sector of Ukraine.

comment.narrative: Universities participate in a study visit on regenerative agroculture in the Netherlands

Ukraine is moving towards European Union (EU) membership and recently obtained candidate status for EU accession. Ukraine is actively implementing its obligations taken under the Deep and Comprehensive Trade Area (DCFTA), actively adjusting local framework to be in line with the EU acquis. Agriculture & Food and Nutrition security has special attention in the national reconstruction plan developed by Ukraine. The agricultural sector needs to undergo transformation to be compliant with the EU agricultural policies. The rol of the agricultural universities is crucial to need to train specialists with the knowledge about EU policies: CAP, Green Deal and modern sustainable practices to match the needs of local agricultural producers that will need to comply with Eu standards. This project facilitated the first steps to address this need of Ukraine.
This project enabled that 10 Ukrainian universities and the Ukrainian Agribusiness Club -UCAB (association of agricultural producers) acquired conceptual and technical understanding of Dutch experience of introducing regenerative agriculture in the Dutch agricultural education. During the mission the participants gained concrete insights on how knowledge to business cooperation works in the Netherlands. This approach matches the current ambitions of the agricultural sector of Ukraine (government and private sector), in line with preparation to future EU accessions and short and medium term steps for reconstruction of the country.
Ukrainian universities that participated in the study visit are: - Poltava State Agrarian University, - National University of Life and Environmental Sciences of Ukraine, - Tavria State Agrotechnological University, - Kherson State Agrarian and Economic, - National University Cherigivska Politechnika, - Luhansk Taras Shevchenko National University, - Uman National University of Horticulture, - Podilskiy National Agrarian University, - Sumy National Agrarian University.
